title: Repair current sky/weather presentation and lunar continuity
body:
The current widget now paints a coherent accepted sky at startup, preserves cloud colour and moving edges, presents fresh current-model weather honestly, and keeps current terrain Moon output through ordinary refinement. Next-prayer emphasis, low-Sun presentation, twilight concentration and dark-side lunar veiling are repaired without replacing the real sky/Moon or changing frozen V1.

**Draft for owner review. Not merged or deployed.** The final follow-up fixes the reproduced fast-clock withdrawal: repeated camera-ray calculations exhausted the unchanged publication reserve. Bounded exact geometry reuse and lazy raw preview planes preserve the numerical fields and displayed bytes while the affected real-browser replays complete without unavailable/expired sky observations.

### Qualified identity

- Head: `4bccdf43363926c3077f60de87e5617ccb9abcb9`
- Base/main: `c1a480c97e9af188cf57704502d818c0584cf265`
- Runtime SHA-256: `f443cf0820e6879dfa7c3ce857d6b2baf554b1fdd2f889433d22e2c532cec260`
- Final Moon-expanded `index.html`: `ff728552442f4bcce7f213a089bf01d4cf70ea8d74040bdd3323768ca453beee`

[Repair report and reproduction commands](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/4bccdf43363926c3077f60de87e5617ccb9abcb9/docs/real-sky/STARTUP_CLOUD_HOTFIX.md) · [175-row qualification matrix](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/4bccdf43363926c3077f60de87e5617ccb9abcb9/docs/real-sky/evidence/startup-cloud-20261007/final-v49/QUALIFICATION.json) · [Evidence manifest](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/4bccdf43363926c3077f60de87e5617ccb9abcb9/docs/real-sky/evidence/startup-cloud-20261007/final-v49/MANIFEST.json)

### Validation and visual evidence

- Windows Chromium 148 and Firefox 150: 16 cold/cache-warm pairs; direct/real iframe, actual file/offline entry, settings, worker recovery and root/V1 isolation. Fresh normal terrain refinement completes in both engines; no blank interval after the first eligible terrain surface in the four final cold/warm sequences. Initial acquisition and full refinement are separately timed.
- Final Firefox 49-hour/600x and Chromium 27-hour/600x traversals: zero expired/unavailable final-document sky observations. Retained full 60x/600x trajectories keep their original runtime and exact-equivalence reuse justification. Screenshot gaps and sparse visual sampling are disclosed.
- Six locations, 30 dated browser anchors per engine: public Orlando, Phoenix, Berlin, Makkah, Tromsø and Sydney. Exact IANA/observer/method/date/currentness checks, captured Aladhan records, labelled synthetic weather, A→B→A, 4350 independent geographical solar-direction checks and DST/polar boundaries. Short city stills are not long playback or fresh terrain solves per city.
- Ordinary current-provider rain/snow, contradictory/missing/expired/wrong-target records and recovery remain separate from simulation. Matched V1/c1/PR42 replay proves the old current-model rain→cloud downgrade and restored condition/particles. The owner's historical payload is unavailable; the final unintercepted public-Orlando check reports current-model overcast, not a reconstruction of their rain.
- Matched V38/V49 clear/partial/overcast night scenes preserve all six raw astronomical fields, exposure and attributed faint-star pixels. Five card pairs are pixel-exact; Chromium partial retains an upper-cloud-region difference of at most eight codes, with lower stars unchanged. The owner attachment's exact capture identity remains unknown.
- 613 Node tests: 609 pass, four explicit TODOs; Python 33 pass; Moon 55 pass. Exactly eight named historical native failures remain, with identical test identities. Two deterministic builds match all 135 runtime hashes. V1 verifier and disposable tamper control pass.

Selected comparisons: [warm-rain startup](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/4bccdf43363926c3077f60de87e5617ccb9abcb9/docs/real-sky/evidence/startup-cloud-20261007/final-v49/visual-review/firefox-startup-rain.png), [normal Firefox Moon continuity](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/4bccdf43363926c3077f60de87e5617ccb9abcb9/docs/real-sky/evidence/startup-cloud-20261007/final-v49/visual-review/firefox-moon-warm-motion.png), [fresh refined offline Moon](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/4bccdf43363926c3077f60de87e5617ccb9abcb9/docs/real-sky/evidence/startup-cloud-20261007/final-v49/runs/joined-v49-final-firefox-moon-offline/half.png), [matched star richness](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/4bccdf43363926c3077f60de87e5617ccb9abcb9/docs/real-sky/evidence/startup-cloud-20261007/final-v49/runs/joined-v49-final-firefox-matched-richness/matched-complete.png), [geography](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/4bccdf43363926c3077f60de87e5617ccb9abcb9/docs/real-sky/evidence/startup-cloud-20261007/final-v49/runs/joined-v49-final-firefox-geography/geography.png).

Original three independent reviews plus two Sol 6.1/Max geography reviews, disagreements, negative controls and primary resolutions are retained in the matrix. No speculative concern is silently promoted to a blocker or an independent PASS. The `SIM×600 /4°` frame was synthetic WMO73 snow, not demonstrated daytime stars; its withdrawn dark background was a real repaired availability failure.

### Limits and publication boundary

H1–H8 are supported within the finite ordinary-mode/current-preview matrix. **N001/N002 remain PARTIAL; N003 remains BLOCKED.** Fast current preview is not full physical/diffuse/terrain throughput at every 60x/600x frame. Actual OS/BFCache, arbitrary scheduling stalls, original personal incident inputs and uncalibrated presentation/optical proxies retain their stated limits. No full V5 scientific campaign was repeated or claimed complete. The generated standalone offline file remains about 77 MB; GitHub accepted it with its existing large-file warning.

No V1/vendor payload changes, main write, merge, auto-merge, branch deletion or PR38 change. GitHub exposes no PR checks or repository rulesets at final readback; local receipts are not GitHub CI. Public root remains c1 until an owner-authorized merge and its exact Pages build.

### Owner merge/deploy recommendation — do not replay PR39/40/41

After independent review, run from a clean checkout of this exact head. Stop if the head, main or protections changed; requalify the affected combination rather than silently substituting another commit.

```powershell
$repo = 'theislampill/salah_widget'
$qualifiedHead = '4bccdf43363926c3077f60de87e5617ccb9abcb9'
$qualifiedBase = 'c1a480c97e9af188cf57704502d818c0584cf265'
$pr = gh pr view 42 --repo $repo --json headRefOid,baseRefOid,state | ConvertFrom-Json
$main = gh api "repos/$repo/branches/main" --jq '.commit.sha'
if ($pr.state -ne 'OPEN' -or $pr.headRefOid -ne $qualifiedHead -or $pr.baseRefOid -ne $qualifiedBase -or $main -ne $qualifiedBase) { throw 'Reviewed identities changed' }
gh api "repos/$repo/rulesets"
gh pr checks 42 --repo $repo
# Satisfy any newly required reviews/checks; never use --admin or bypass protection.
gh pr ready 42 --repo $repo
gh pr merge 42 --repo $repo --merge --match-head-commit $qualifiedHead
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Merge did not succeed' }
$merge = gh pr view 42 --repo $repo --json mergeCommit --jq '.mergeCommit.oid'
gh api "repos/$repo/pages/builds/latest" --jq '{commit,status,error}'
```

Poll the last read-only Pages query until **`commit == $merge` and `status == built`**. An older successful build does not qualify. Stop on a build error or an unexpected later main/deployment commit. Then compare the served files against the pinned [runtime manifest](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/4bccdf43363926c3077f60de87e5617ccb9abcb9/docs/real-sky/evidence/startup-cloud-20261007/final-v49/CANDIDATE_RUNTIME.json), especially the final root index above, and these immutable V1 values:

| Public file under `/salah_widget/` | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `v1/index.html` | `99d930297deb2755205930c7850b89584e03f431ced0671638071162732ef766` |
| `v1/config.js` | `f169d26ad015d3fcb6b5782fde43a83e0f31275bbbeb80c94c51a6c3bc4aa56d` |
| `v1/VERSION.json` | `dda56a94c56ec6295e8eb9af890e6913878731385cc180c250fff3d532b2d330` |
| `v1/MANIFEST.sha256` | `aa4bfcbc54f838e93d8ab41e58845efd753fcea80e8ebef3a784acf304e6a4cb` |

Smoke both `/#local=1` and `/v1/#local=1` in the actual 330×534 iframe (325×530 card), using the owner's existing geolocation/referrer/scrolling attributes. Check prayer/settings/weather, current refined lunar pixels after the documented acquisition interval, local assets and V1 isolation. This **post-merge live repair check remains pending**; the existing V1 endpoint itself was already verified available and unchanged.

title: Preserve deployed pre-overhaul widget at /v1/
body:
Preserve the currently deployed pre-overhaul widget at `/salah_widget/v1/` before the renderer changes reach the root URL. The current root application remains byte-identical. This is a separate **Draft PR against main** for independent review; no merge, auto-merge or deployment is requested.

### Production identity

- Base/source commit: `fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624`; tree `c5382ee6cb32e71992da963f56b00c2eaa091d1c`.
- Preservation head: `f1d056c90f32223475cc91f5e03ce3dba35508c9` on `preserve/v1-production-snapshot`.
- The live root entry and `config.js` HTTP response bodies matched those Git blobs byte-for-byte. Pages build `1049380309`, deployment `5087774417` and successful run `27657616486` name the same source commit. Main was freshly fetched again before publication and had not moved.
- [Provenance, dependency audit and pending live smoke](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/f1d056c90f32223475cc91f5e03ce3dba35508c9/docs/V1_PRESERVATION.md) · [production receipt](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/f1d056c90f32223475cc91f5e03ce3dba35508c9/docs/v1/evidence/production.json).

### Scope

Copy only the two local runtime files into V1, retaining inline assets and original comments. The only application adaptations isolate the settings key, prayer/weather cache prefixes and temporary storage probe. A one-time schema-validated import copies legacy settings into V1 while leaving root storage untouched; reset retains an import marker and caches are not imported.

Add VERSION/manifest, a hash verifier with a disposable tamper control, focused storage/browser tests, evidence and preservation guidance. Preserve the user's exact `330×534` iframe and the existing `325×530` card. Relative `config.js` loads from `/v1/config.js`. No root runtime, deployment configuration or renderer branch is modified.

### Validation

- `python tools/verify_v1.py --check-root --check-pages --negative-control`: PASS; intentional frozen-file change detected.
- `node tests/v1_storage.cjs`: **10 passed, 0 failed**.
- Installed Windows Chromium `148.0.7778.96`: actual iframe forms at `/salah_widget/#local=1` and `/salah_widget/v1/#local=1`; controlled time, observer, provider responses, settings, fonts, viewport and DPR.
- **0 differing pixels** in day/DPR1, night/DPR1 and day/DPR2 comparisons. Captures inspected; header, six rows, countdown, dates/footer and settings remain inside the unchanged layout.
- Both paths pass coarse location, geolocation grant/denial, manual recovery and settings reload; all six comparison scenes advance the countdown. V1 settings/cache isolation passes. Replacing mutable root index/config in a disposable copy leaves V1 pixel-identical.
- Zero unexpected page errors or failed fixture/local-asset requests. Final frozen hashes and diff hygiene pass; root index/config/builder/installers/preset are unchanged.
- [Screenshots and exact results](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/f1d056c90f32223475cc91f5e03ce3dba35508c9/docs/v1/evidence/VALIDATION.md) · [browser receipt](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/f1d056c90f32223475cc91f5e03ce3dba35508c9/docs/v1/evidence/browser-results.json).

### Renderer compatibility and limits

PR #39 remains Draft at `1977217cc2ac26fcc436b991aff498d306a0cd26`, based on main. PR #40 remains Draft at `890d5bdbc1244ad90e1113a86d60b25214daa7b0`, based on #39's branch. Object-only `git merge-tree` checks found no conflicts with either, preserved the complete V1 tree, and retained their respective root runtime blobs. Their existing builders write explicit root/real-sky/moon outputs, not V1; no renderer builds or campaigns were rerun.

No PR #38/#39/#40 runtime was used as a donor and no V5 archive was inspected. Remote services and fonts remain mutable; clock, location and timetable remain live. Same-origin namespaces are compatibility isolation, not a security boundary; browser partitioning/blocked storage can limit migration. Permission tests use browser emulation, not physical GPS or an actual Tabliss host.

Pages currently uses a successful Jekyll build from `main` `/`; V1's ordinary static files meet its inclusion rules. Old run text logs expired (HTTP 410), but build/job/deployment metadata and live runtime byte comparisons establish correspondence. **Public `/v1/` verification remains pending owner-authorized merge and deployment.** The documented post-merge smoke is not a deployment approval, and this PR does not close renderer qualification obligations.

title: Integrate V5 terrain Moon on CP9 and fix horizon edge
body:
Integrates the supplied V5 terrain Moon into CP9 while preserving native prayer/settings, fallback/retry, currentness and cloud/opacity ownership. Corrects the inherited bottom-horizon strip, the shifted/duplicated outer lunar limb, and Firefox normal-clock preview starvation.

Corrected head: **b0856cf6107e62a06d3d31c9e63adf4e62d026bf** (`FIXED_MOON_HEAD`). This is an additive follow-up to 890d5bdbc1244ad90e1113a86d60b25214daa7b0, with no rebase or force-push. CP9 source head remains 1977217cc2ac26fcc436b991aff498d306a0cd26. Runtime SHA256: `b234edc0f5cecb19a49c153130cb9a1c555aa6322dd28473f0a94e502ea7ee49`.

The rim came from a one-CSS-pixel containing-block offset and a lower-resolution Moon drawn underneath the terrain layer. The current refined layer now owns the visible Moon; loading/failure fallback remains. Firefox was cancelling viable work on fixed angular bucket crossings. Buckets now use the actual displayed device-pixel diameter while retaining the original **0.0416-device-pixel geometric error budget**. Generation/location/configuration, explicit seeks, profile/reference, waxing/waning, hidden/disposed and worker-failure fences remain; the CP9 30-second sky-age limit and terrain quality rules are unchanged.

Validation on installed Windows Chromium 148.0.7778.96 and Firefox 150.0.2:

- Normal 1× exact root/V1 iframe: both reach final adaptive terrain, with live countdown/sky UTC, usable prayer/settings during refinement, failure/retry, V1-local dependencies and isolated storage. Local fixture timings: Chromium 39.80s, Firefox 139.45s. Firefox remains ready through the five-minute trace; preview is not used as final acceptance.
- Nine fresh refined phases, both senses where applicable; 324 phase/DPR/fractional-placement cases. All 43,209 independent outer-limb sample comparisons match exactly. Original code fails the same rim and clock regressions.
- Moon components 38/38; CP9 JavaScript 114/114; CP9 Python 18/18; browser lifecycle 19 cases/386 assertions. File/offline 11 checks and all eight checks for each missing/truncated/corrupt asset control pass. Deterministic regeneration and V1 frozen hashes pass.
- Known native failures remain: one reveal, seven baseline-balance, four TODOs and existing exclusions. N001/N002 remain PARTIAL and N003 BLOCKED. This is a bounded normal-clock rollout, not accelerated-clock or universal scientific qualification.

[Qualification and before/after images](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/b0856cf6107e62a06d3d31c9e63adf4e62d026bf/docs/moon/RELEASE_CANDIDATE.md) · [Clock diagnosis and error derivation](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/b0856cf6107e62a06d3d31c9e63adf4e62d026bf/docs/moon/CLOCK_CURRENTNESS.md) · [Bound evidence manifest](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/b0856cf6107e62a06d3d31c9e63adf4e62d026bf/docs/moon/evidence/clock-20261007/MANIFEST.json).

The user authorized staged merge commits only: #41 first with live V1 verification, then #39, then this exact corrected head retargeted to main. No PR #38 implementation was used; no V5 archive was reopened. The final public deployment is a separate gate from these local receipts.

Rollout completed on 2026-10-07: preservation merge `f49755cfd4e54a5662500ef85353c4fb1529a2a4`, CP9 merge `5f1f00030895a96a71009a1c4825b7327985db7f`, and corrected Moon merge/final main `c1a480c97e9af188cf57704502d818c0584cf265`. Final tree `beb1c39ddc750c22e7276f2ca8a1f8c58bd44d16` exactly matches the locally tested combined tree.

[Final Pages deployment 37612530717](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/actions/runs/37612530717) succeeded for that exact final main. Public root and V1 iframe checks passed in Chromium and Firefox with live providers and no page/local-asset errors. Public normal-clock refinement: 40.95s / 146.63s; separately controlled half-Moon worker: 52.66s / 204.24s. Firefox passed 16 date/settings interactions including refinement. Final terrain crops were inspected; no duplicated outer rim or bottom strip remains. Fourteen published files match the pinned bytes, including all four V1 records; V1 manifest SHA256 remains `aa4bfcbc54f838e93d8ab41e58845efd753fcea80e8ebef3a784acf304e6a4cb`.

[Current widget](https://theislampill.github.io/salah_widget/#local=1) · [Frozen V1](https://theislampill.github.io/salah_widget/v1/#local=1). The CP9 branch remains at its reviewed head. No branches were deleted, no protection was bypassed, and PR #38 remains unmerged. Historical native failures and N001/N002/N003 statuses remain as disclosed above.

title: Integrate cumulative CP9 real sky and advance its implementation DAG
body:
Integrates the supplied cumulative CP1–CP9 real-sky product with the current prayer widget and advances its post-CP9 implementation DAG. The candidate adds the admitted catalogue, registered diffuse field, physical-sky worker, source/currentness fences, native PBR/cloud composition, deterministic build and offline entry. It also implements exact display encoding and rate-aware scheduling at their authored owners.

**Draft only. Do not merge or treat this as release qualification.** N001 review, N002 high-rate availability and N003 final acceptance remain open. This branch is ready for independent comparison and a separately supplied Moon-PBR package.

## Identity and independence

| Boundary | Identity |

| CP9 recorded native/source commit | `205750350c64b77ebdc3ebcadcc39a6eb949994b` |

The supplied on-disk filename lacks the `(1)` suffix in the request; the file above was verified locally. ZIP CRC, all 2,230 manifest payloads, the 162-file native baseline, 950-file scientific inventory and 213-file cumulative product inventory verified. CP9 records parent CP8.3 archive `a056d3789cb614355cc27af286907add231293ba42b2288894cdd3edca8d29a3` and scientific CP7.6 archive `f30470a68d02e47d83e5fd0d063a5320936802161e5d2b9ba701ba48d72f5e45`.

**PR #38 was not fetched, changed, merged, rebased, cherry-picked or used as an implementation donor.** This is a fresh Git history from current main using the supplied archive. Independence refers to this integration; the archive's recorded native provenance is preserved, not represented as different historical ancestry. Locally available archive-pinned historical commits were read only as regression controls, not product donors.

## Reconciliation and review boundaries

Current main has 34 files: 22 are byte-identical to CP9's native baseline and twelve differ; no main-only file is absent from the archive. The meaningful baseline→CP9 product delta is 51 additions and eleven changed files (generated index plus ten fixture adaptations). Main's resolved-latitude solar calculation and 325×530 embed geometry remain intact. No newer main-only semantic conflict appeared on the final fetch.

Native admission/generation, accepted clock/calendar, weather evidence, cloud continuity, lunar opacity/fallback, configuration, installer safeguards and builder recovery prerequisites are carried from the supplied native baseline. The fixture's omitted `_pbrFailed` declaration was reproduced as 129 failures and reconciled using CP9's existing declaration extraction. Assertions were not relaxed. Historical synthetic-producer and pre-CP9 PBR-byte comparisons remain explicitly failed/excluded within their documented scopes.

Authored native sources live in `src/native/`; authored adapters in `real-sky/native-*`; `tools/build_native.py` deterministically owns root entries, bundles, worker, data, CSS, copied core and offline expansion. All three native sources and 186 selected scientific source/build/test files retain exact archive bytes. Scientific tests run in a disposable copy. No ZIP, copied `widget/` tree, gallery, reconciliation donor or earlier checkpoint archive is installed as product. Required source data and scientific fixtures are retained; duplicate delivery data in the root bundle/offline expansion is intentional.

Five reviewable commits separate:

1. `3cf6ce2` — native prerequisite/source reconciliation.
2. `7fe3ba1` — cumulative astronomy, composition, assets and deterministic build.
3. `affbae4` — DAG-driven encoding and rate-scheduling implementation.
4. `c48c537` — current-runtime tests, actual-entry runners and acceptance collector.
5. `1977217` — ownership, DAG ledger and hash-bound qualification evidence.

## DAG progress

Starting state: **11 historically CLOSED findings, B001 BOUNDARY, and N001/N002/N003 OPEN**. N001 and N002 are independently ready; N003 runner preparation can start early, but final acceptance requires both on one final runtime. Historical receipts were not promoted to current PASS.

All 20 final sandbox-enabled candidate stress trials meet the unchanged 250 ms heartbeat/dialog limits: maxima 148.6 / 106.8 ms. All 8,047 opaque lunar samples and the full-frame/moved-Moon equation have zero code difference; cache/memory/lifecycle controls pass. | **PARTIAL: technical observations pass within stated scope; independent source/oracle review pending.** |
| N002 / F102 | Rate-aware scheduling, identical-force coalescing, preserved newer in-flight work on displayed-frame expiry, and finite unsupported-rate diagnostics. 1×/10× produce 3/6 new frames and 83/100 visible samples each. 60×/600× still produce zero; all rates preserve stale safety and exact frozen recovery. | **PARTIAL: real high-rate throughput work remains.** No timestamp relabelling, future clock, age-limit relaxation or scientific tier reduction. |
| N003 / F103 | Strict evidence collector and rejection controls; actual HTTP/index and file/offline entries, explicit browser identities, CSP, real navigation, failure/retry, prayer/calendar/settings, and separate live provider observations. Chromium HTTP demonstrates a persisted BFCache return and fresh current renderer. | **Final join BLOCKED on N001/N002; platform evidence PARTIAL.** Other persisted BFCache entries, file deployment-policy evidence and independent review remain incomplete. |

The eleven inherited fixes were requalified within their original scopes, with no new closure credit; B001 remains an explicit scientific/presentation boundary. No mandatory open node is newly declared closed. See the [per-cell implementation/evidence ledger](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/1977217cc2ac26fcc436b991aff498d306a0cd26/docs/real-sky/DAG_LEDGER.json).

## Validation and limitations

Qualification used Windows build 26200, Node 22.16.0, Python 3.11.9, Playwright 1.57.0, NumPy 2.3.5 and Pillow 12.2.0. Engines: Chromium 148.0.7778.96, Firefox 150.0.2 and **Windows-host Playwright WebKit 26.0**, not Apple Safari/macOS qualification.

| Final `cp9_performance.py --trials 5`, no concurrent browser/solver campaign | **20/20 candidate trials PASS**, current physical sky, six rows, eight dialog actions per trial, no page errors. Baseline controls reported separately. |
| Material / composition / presentation / resource lifetime | Zero-code lunar/full-frame comparisons; three wrong equations rejected; 13 cache controls pass; eight restarts then disposal leave zero worker/URL/canvas resources. Main-heap growth 36,956 bytes; not total memory proof. |
