title: R001B: Document actual recipients of search queries and location-derived requests
body:
<!-- salah-widget-audit-20260907:SW-027 -->
# R001B: Document actual recipients of search queries and location-derived requests

**Repository-local identity:** `R001B` in `theislampill/salah_widget`; existing tracker [#27](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/27). The SW identifier is historical draft provenance.


Campaign draft alias: SW-027. Documentation defect; proposed P2. Repair only the existing privacy/data-flow explanation; no network policy or provider-retention conclusion is authorized.

## Evidence and exact target

The preserved 7 September 2026 source audit found README's privacy section names GeoJS/ipinfo and browser geolocation, while its API section names prayer/weather requests. Builder's privacy note names GeoJS only. They omit manual search and reverse-geocode recipients. On both main fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 and candidate 9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb, controlled original-source calls produced these exact URLs:

~~~text
https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=jsonv2&addressdetails=1&limit=5&q=M5V2T6
https://api.zippopotam.us/ca/M5V
https://api.bigdatacloud.net/data/reverse-geocode-client?latitude=51.5&longitude=-0.12&localityLanguage=en
~~~

The first two came from geocodeSearch("M5V2T6", {}) with fetch intercepted; the third from builder fillNameFromCoords at 51.5,-0.12 with automatic naming/method still enabled. They are controlled URL-construction evidence, not recorded external transmission or a tracking/retention finding. Existing disclosures are a partial contrary control; describing local persistence does not describe all computation as local.

Before authorized editing, record root, theislampill/salah_widget remote, HEAD and dirty state, then inspect relevant drift:

~~~sh
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
git diff fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 -- README.md builder.html config.js index.html
~~~

Write [README, Auto-detect, precise location & privacy](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/README.md#L113) and [builder privacy note](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/builder.html#L178). The candidate has the same omission: [README](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb/README.md#L113). index.html/config.js and lookup callsites are verification owners only.

## Replacement wording and source ledger

Replace the incomplete README disclosure with this compact introduction and table, retaining the existing useful geolocation-permission guidance:

> Settings are stored in your browser/profile, but the widget and builder use external services. Local storage does not make search or location-based requests local-only. Coarse detection is approximate; precise browser location is optional and requested by your action. The requests below depend on the feature used, cache state and network availability.

| Trigger | Recipient and fields |
|---|---|
| Builder's initial area detection; widget local/preferLocal mode when it needs detection; an accepted Reset/re-detect action | GeoJS, then ipinfo.io on failure. The request exposes the connection's IP address. The provider URLs have no user-entered location/query parameters; the device timezone is used locally in configuration resolution. |
| Builder location-name input after its search debounce or Enter; widget Settings place/postcode search on Enter | Nominatim receives the typed query as q. A digit-containing query may also send the current home-country bias as countrycodes. |
| A search whose whitespace-stripped text begins with letter-digit-letter | Zippopotam receives the uppercase first three characters in its /ca/ path, in addition to Nominatim receiving the query. This is the implemented prefix trigger, not proof the complete input is a valid Canadian postcode. |
| Builder automatic name/method lookup after eligible coordinate input or a precise-location result | BigDataCloud reverse-geocode-client receives latitude, longitude and localityLanguage=en. The in-widget precise path itself does not call this builder reverse function. |
| Prayer-time loading and refresh for the configured location | Aladhan receives latitude, longitude, calculation method, school and requested date. |
| Weather loading and refresh when real-weather acquisition is active | Open-Meteo receives latitude, longitude, timezone, requested units and weather-field selections. |
| Radar loading and refresh when real-weather acquisition is active | RainViewer receives a weather-map manifest request; the returned tile host receives a frame/tile path whose x/y indices are derived from the configured location. |
| Page font loading, subject to browser caching | Google Fonts stylesheet/font hosts receive font resource requests. These resource URLs do not contain the widget's location or search text. |

Follow with:

> Reset removes the saved widget configuration key. It does not clear prayer/weather caches or erase information held by external services. Browser or embedding-host storage and permission policies can limit persistence or precise location. This description identifies client-side request construction; it makes no claim about providers' retention practices.

Source trace: [coarseDetect](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/config.js#L174), [geocodeSearch](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/config.js#L293), [builder reverse/GPS](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/builder.html#L292), [timings](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L743), [weather/radar](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L771), [font declarations](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L7), [configured-key removal](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/config.js#L160).

Use this shorter builder note, linking "Request details" to README's privacy section using the repository's existing link convention:

> Self-configuring location is approximate and uses GeoJS, with ipinfo.io as fallback. Place/postcode searches go to Nominatim and, for matching Canadian-style prefixes, Zippopotam. Builder reverse lookups send coordinates to BigDataCloud; the widget also requests prayer, weather, radar and font resources. Saved settings stay in your browser, which does not prevent these service requests. Precise location is optional and requires browser/host permission. Request details.

Retain the current explanation that an iframe host can strip allow="geolocation" and that coarse/manual setup remain available. Coordinate the persistence-failure sentence with [R0011](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/17); do not claim its UI repair has shipped before readback. No blanket "stores nothing on any server" or "does no tracking" assertion can stand in for the specific recipient description.

## Validation, alternatives and completion

A future deterministic documentation check should invoke the real source functions with intercepted fetch and the public values above. Assert the exact Nominatim q, Zippopotam /ca/M5V and reverse latitude/longitude. Negative controls: "London" requests Nominatim without a Canadian-prefix request; an input shorter than two trimmed characters produces no search; builder reverse lookup with both labelAuto and methodAuto disabled makes no reverse request. These controls demonstrate the stated triggers and prevent an overbroad "every edit sends coordinates" claim.

For each table row, record the final-tree callsite/constructed fields; do not call a private probe as the public recipe. Read the rendered README and builder note for legibility and agreement. No new test framework or network trace service is needed. Changes in providers, URL fields, lookup triggers or Reset scope are the explicit revisit triggers.

A link-only privacy notice would hide the specific missing recipients. A new consent workflow, provider replacement or legal policy is broader than this evidence. More exhaustive browser fingerprint/retention claims would be unsupported. The selected repair is exact text plus a bounded source trace.

Only README and builder prose change; preserve controls, generated payloads, 325×530 card and runtime behavior. Existing documentation-integrator ownership and typed relationships remain unchanged. Roll back only inaccurate wording if validation fails; do not roll back correct recipient disclosure or mutate runtime to fit prose. Stop if current callsites differ materially and update only the affected rows.

DONE requires the final text and source trace, an evidence comment and later rendered public-document readback if claiming published disclosure. Use non-closing Implements #27 PR wording and manual closure after evidence. No runtime or independent PASS is asserted by this document.

title: R001A: Give builder option groups standard keyboard radio interaction
body:
<!-- salah-widget-audit-20260907:SW-026 -->
# R001A: Give builder option groups standard keyboard radio interaction

**Repository-local identity:** `R001A` in `theislampill/salah_widget`; existing tracker [#26](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/26). The SW identifier is historical draft provenance.


Campaign draft alias: SW-026. Existing-control defect; proposed P2. This is the two-button Embed type group, not a builder accessibility redesign.

## Actual browser witness

At the preserved main tree fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624, the UI lane used a real 375×800 browser viewport, focused Portable and pressed ArrowRight. Focus stayed on mode-portable. aria-checked stayed true/false, and **both controls had tabIndex 0**. The saved native DOM readback is:

~~~json
{
  "viewport":[375,800],
  "active":"mode-portable",
  "radios":[
    {"id":"mode-portable","checked":"true","tabindex":0},
    {"id":"mode-local","checked":"false","tabindex":0}
  ]
}
~~~

The accompanying screenshot was retained by the audit. This authoring pass has not rerun the browser. The positive control matters: focusing Self-configuring and pressing Space did select it. Users have a Tab-plus-Space route; the finding is missing radio-group interaction, not inability to select a mode. No screen-reader speech matrix was measured. builder.html is unchanged between the preserved main and candidate 9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb.

The [markup](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/builder.html#L164) declares role=radiogroup with two button role=radio children. [setMode and wiring](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/builder.html#L211) update selected classes and aria-checked but attach only click handlers. Native button activation explains why Space works; declaring radio roles does not supply native radio arrow behavior.

## Narrow design

Before authorized implementation, record root, remote, HEAD and dirty state and run:

~~~sh
git diff fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 -- builder.html tests/smoke.html
~~~

Expect theislampill/salah_widget and stop if the group was already replaced or its values/callers changed. The [candidate source](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb/builder.html#L164) is comparison evidence.

Keep the existing buttons and finish their small roving-tabindex model. This is smaller than changing markup, CSS and click consumers to native inputs in this two-control group.

1. Have setMode continue to be the single selected-state owner. In the same pass that sets active and aria-checked, set the selected button's tabIndex to 0 and the other to -1. Initial setMode("portable") establishes the invariant before keyboard use. Programmatic mode changes must update all three values too.
2. Add one keydown handler on .modebtns for ArrowRight/ArrowDown (next) and ArrowLeft/ArrowUp (previous). Build the ordered eligible list from the existing group buttons, excluding disabled controls. Only handle an event whose target is one of those controls. Prevent default for handled arrows, wrap within this group, focus the target and invoke setMode with its existing portable/local value once.
3. Preserve native button Enter/Space→click activation. Do not also call setMode on their keydown events, which could double-activate or reload the preview twice. Tab/Shift+Tab must remain native: one stop enters the group at its selection, and the next leaves it. Do not trap Tab or use arrow handlers on the whole document.
4. Retain visible focus CSS and all existing mode effects: generated hash, preview reload, explanatory text and local-only geolocation allow. The selection and generated output must agree after keyboard, mouse and programmatic changes.

The invariant is exactly one selected/checked/tabbable enabled radio for this group, with native focus and activation behavior preserved. With only one enabled control, arrows remain on it; with none, do not manufacture a selection or throw. Those are defensive fixture controls, not a requested new disabled-state feature.

Replacing roles with generic buttons would abandon the intended mutually exclusive semantics. Adding tabindex alone fixes neither arrows nor state synchronization. Native radio inputs are a credible alternative if the current source has materially changed, but then document the smaller actual diff and requalify CSS and native behavior; do not mix both interaction models. A reusable accessibility framework is disproportionate here.

## Public RED→GREEN recipe

On a disposable served builder, record exact served source identity; use real browser keyboard events, not dispatchEvent as a substitute for native default behavior. At 375×800, focus #mode-portable and press ArrowRight. Baseline result is the JSON above. Repaired expected state is:

~~~json
{
  "active":"mode-local",
  "radios":[
    {"id":"mode-portable","checked":"false","tabindex":-1},
    {"id":"mode-local","checked":"true","tabindex":0}
  ],
  "embedMode":"local"
}
~~~

Also inspect the actual generated iframe hash for local=1, local-only allow="geolocation" and width:325px;height:530px. Do not infer configuration from checked text alone.

| Native interaction/control | Required result |
|---|---|
| Tab into group from preceding focusable control | Selected radio receives focus; next Tab leaves group. Shift+Tab re-enters selection. |
| Right from Portable, Right from Local | Local then wrap to Portable, each with selected/focused/output state agreeing. |
| Left from Portable; Up/Down in the group | Same defined reverse/forward wrap; no document scrolling caused by handled arrows. |
| Space or Enter on either button | One native click activation and one mode update, no double preview reload. |
| Mouse/touch click, then leave/re-enter by keyboard | Clicked value becomes the single tabbable selection. |
| Programmatic setMode("local") | aria-checked, active class, tabIndex and generated output all reflect local. |
| Mutation: omit arrow handler or one tabIndex update | Native arrow or single-tabstop assertion fails. |

Capture focused selected/unselected crops at mobile and ordinary desktop widths. Inspect that the focus indicator is visible and text does not clip. The historic keyboard fixture is already a real-browser result, but source inspection alone cannot qualify the new native key behavior. Do not claim assistive-technology speech support without that separate observed environment.

## Scope and completion

Only builder group wiring/state and a focused regression change. No new preference semantics, serialized values, config.js, widget settings focus trap, installers or preset changes. [R0010](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/16) still owns what the selected local preferences mean; this work must preserve its output rather than redefine it. Existing shared test/docs insertion ownership stays with the integrator; no new typed dependency is proposed.

Rollback group changes as a unit if click/Space behavior, preview or focus visibility regresses. Stop on incompatible group drift or missing native keyboard evidence. DONE requires final-tree native RED→GREEN and controls, exact-tree review of double activation/Tab behavior, evidence comment, and served builder readback if claiming public repair. Use non-closing Implements #26 PR wording and manual closure after evidence. This document is not a new rendered PASS.

title: R0019: Expose complete calendar values when supported date formats overflow the fixed footer
body:
<!-- salah-widget-audit-20260907:SW-025 -->
# R0019: Expose complete calendar values when supported date formats overflow the fixed footer

**Repository-local identity:** `R0019` in `theislampill/salah_widget`; existing tracker [#25](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/25). The SW identifier is historical draft provenance.


The supplied long-date format overflows both footer values at the supported 325×530 size. Keep deliberate compact ellipsis, but make either date an explicit keyboard/touch entry to a small full-value disclosure that shows both selected calendar values and their existing status. Do not enlarge the embed or recompute a second, potentially conflicting AH date.

Campaign draft alias: SW-025. Existing GitHub owner: #25. P2, product UI defect. This is a corrective access mechanism; no broader footer redesign or calendar policy is selected. The proposed interaction has not been built or browser-qualified.

## Re-anchor and preserve the actual failure

Historical main is `fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624`; candidate is `9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb`. In the future authorized checkout record `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, `git remote get-url origin`, `git status --short`, `git rev-parse HEAD`, then inspect `git diff fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 -- index.html builder.html tests/smoke.html README.md DESIGN.md`. Confirm `theislampill/salah_widget`, preserve unrelated work and reconcile relevant date-output/accessibility drift.

Owners are [main footer CSS](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L387), [existing footer elements](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L510), [selected date renderer](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L2003), [candidate date renderer/title](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb/index.html#L2033), and [builder format controls](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/builder.html#L132).

The saved candidate browser run used Madinah, local `2026-09-08 12:30`, the supplied `DD MMMM YYYY` format and an actual 325×530 viewport. Its DOM readback was:

| Element | Complete DOM text | scrollWidth / clientWidth | Other observed facts |
|---|---|---|---|
| `#ce` | `08 September 2026CE` | 132 / 110 px | Empty title; tabIndex −1; bottom 517.7677 px. |
| `#ah` | `ه26 Rabīʿ al-awwal 1448 | 🌘 27` | 187 / 155 px | Convention explanation in title, without the full date; tabIndex −1; bottom 518.6906 px. |

The paired source/screenshot evidence shows intentional single-line `white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis`. The card itself is not clipped: footer bottom 518.69 is inside 530. Both dates remain in the DOM, so this is not proof of complete information loss to every assistive technology. The visible long-format crop and absence of a keyboard/touch disclosure establish the narrower defect. No historical measurement says that every custom format or screen reader fails.

## Missing contract and selected interaction

The current code treats “string present in DOM” as enough, although a built-in format cannot be read visually. Native `title` on a nonfocusable span does not supply a reliable keyboard/touch interaction. At the other extreme, fitting arbitrary custom strings into one footer line is impossible without truncation, tiny text or changed geometry.

Use one in-widget full-date disclosure, opened from either footer value. The default view retains both existing IDs, text/era/preview structure and compact styling. A small native button for each date is the proposed trigger, not a new preference or a one-time overflow detector. Keep the disclosure available even when a current short value fits, so long values, fallback fonts and date changes do not require different interaction rules.

Implement in ordered, observable stages:

1. Wrap the existing `#ce` and `#ah` spans in stable `type="button"` date triggers inside `.d`. Preserve those IDs as the renderer's text owners and scope ellipsis to the visible value spans, not every span in a future panel. Reset button font/border/background and apply `min-inline-size:0` plus the current flex allocation so wrapping does not expand the date row. Retain `.d`'s height, margin, gap and direction. Add a visible keyboard focus treatment and a discoverable hover/focus/tap affordance that does not consume extra line height.
2. Add one bounded, labeled native `dialog` inside the widget document for the complete date view, styled with the existing restrained glass/color vocabulary. Use actual buttons and text content; no framework or tooltip library. The opened dialog is an explicit overlay within the iframe viewport, not a row inserted into the prayer stack. Limit its width to the card viewport minus safe side margins, its height to the available viewport, and allow internal vertical scrolling. Long custom strings use normal wrapping and `overflow-wrap:anywhere`; neither horizontal overflow nor a shrunken one-line font is an acceptable fallback.
3. Populate the dialog with clearly labeled Gregorian and Hijri full values, the current preview when present, and the already-selected stale/unavailable/provenance explanation. Use the exact strings and decision that the footer renderer just selected. Do not call the provider, increment AH, or independently call `fmtDate()` against a new `today/tomorrow` choice from the click handler. A tiny ephemeral projection shared by the footer and disclosure is justified because both have real consumers; no new saved configuration schema is needed.
4. Opening either trigger displays both full values and moves focus into the dialog; Close and Escape dismiss it and restore focus to the initiating trigger when still present. Preserve native dialog focus containment and ensure its heading, close button and full values have sensible accessible names. The value remains selectable/readable, and touch users can scroll long content. If native dialog behavior is unavailable in a supported host, stop the compatibility claim and supply an explicitly tested small fallback before closure; do not silently degrade to `title` alone.
5. Keep the button/dialog nodes stable across the existing per-render date update. Update text only when the selected text or explanation changes; do not rebuild the focused trigger/dialog each tick. While open, a Maghrib/date/source transition updates the same full values and reason; it does not close the panel, steal focus or announce the whole unchanged panel every second. The next open always reflects the latest rendered selection. Empty/invalid dates have explicit unavailable text and never reveal stale hidden content from a prior selection.

Do not reuse the settings close/autosave path for this read-only disclosure: [the current settings close handler commits settings](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L2437). Reading full dates must not apply settings, trigger geocoding, write storage or refetch prayer data. The native dialog can remain behaviorally separate without adding a new app-wide overlay controller. Qualify that normal settings use and a restored footer focus still work; do not take ownership of settings preference semantics.

## Standalone RED/GREEN and interaction fixtures

For a future deterministic RED, freeze the test browser before initialization at `2026-09-08T09:30:00.000Z`, use `#lat=24.47&lon=39.61&label=Madinah&method=4&tz=Asia%2FRiyadh&simTime=12:30&simWx=0&datefmt=DD%20MMMM%20YYYY`, and return day/zone-matching prayer data on a disposable origin. For the captured footer strings, provide Gregorian day `08`, month `{number:9,en:"September"}`, year `2026`; selected AH day `26`, month `{number:3,en:"Rabīʿ al-awwal"}`, year `1448`; tomorrow AH day `27`, with Gregorian request date `09-09-2026`. Set AH method metadata to `HJCoSA`. These are display fixture values, not an adjudication of the owner's separate 24-versus-26 observation. Provide a valid timing set and keep the clock before its Maghrib.

Let rows/fonts settle; measure `innerWidth/innerHeight` and `.c` rather than trusting requested device emulation. The original widths are historical evidence, not brittle exact-pixel expectations for every final browser/font. RED is demonstrated overflow with no usable full-value interaction. Repaired GREEN can retain overflow in the compact spans, provided complete values are obtainable through the specified interaction.

| Case | Required final-tree result |
|---|---|
| Supplied formats `YYYY-MM-DD`, `MM/DD/YYYY`, `DD/MM/YYYY`, `DD MMMM YYYY` | Both full formatted dates can be obtained from either trigger; compact format keeps its established normal appearance. |
| Saved long-format fixture | Dialog shows all of `08 September 2026` and `26 Rabīʿ al-awwal 1448`, with separate clear calendar labels and preview 27/phase where applicable; no missing year or clipped tail. |
| Keyboard | Tab reaches each trigger; Enter and Space open; dialog focus is contained; Close and Escape return to the actual initiating control; a render tick does not drop focus. |
| Touch/pointer | Either visible date opens the same full-value view; Close works without hover; long text can be scrolled and selected within bounds. |
| Long custom literal / fallback font | Repeated long text and a long month name remain fully obtainable without horizontal overflow; block the web font in the isolated fixture and repeat. No promise that arbitrary text fits one line. |
| Preview/stale/unavailable and transition while open | Full values and reasons match the same footer selection before/after Maghrib, missing tomorrow, midnight promotion and delayed arrival. Prayer staleness is not silently substituted for AH update availability. |
| Unsafe literal and missing value | `<svg onload="window.__sw_sec_probe=1"></svg>`, Arabic, ampersands and quotes remain literal; no injected nodes or event. Missing/invalid value shows unavailable, never a stale prior hidden date. |
| No-effect read | Opening/closing changes no config/storage keys, request count, prayer method or selected date. The isolated fixture records those boundaries. |
| Mutations | Replace the trigger with title-only spans: keyboard/touch test fails. Recompute AH from `today` on click: post-Maghrib selected-value test fails. Rebuild open dialog every tick: focus persistence test fails. Remove wrap/bounds: long-text containment test fails. |

Capture default footer, long-format footer and open disclosure crops at actual 325×530, plus keyboard/touch interaction evidence. Verify unchanged prayer stack positions, visible header/footer in the ordinary closed view, era-marker directionality, no buckle changes and the builder's actual iframe preview. A dialog intentionally overlays some content while open; it must remain readable and closeable without changing the fixed card dimensions. No clip or ratio alone proves keyboard access.

## Interfaces, public projection and closure

Existing qualification dependencies remain [R0001](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/1) for inert text and [R0009](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/9) for truthful selected date/reason. Agree one final `runtime/date-output` writer; this owner consumes the selector's ephemeral text projection rather than owning calendar logic. Its other domain is `ui/date-footer`. No new typed edge or preference schema is proposed. `UI-001` is the unique truncation owner; fixed geometry, explicit English/token assumptions and preset parse/dimensions are retained controls.

IMPLEMENTAUDIT R001D: source footer/disclosure, exact interaction tests and relevant [README](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/README.md)/[DESIGN](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/DESIGN.md) full-value access instructions change. Check builder format preview, changing it only if the resulting supported interaction requires a description adjustment. Config grammar, installer/preset and 325×530 snippet remain compatible. IMPLEMENTAUDIT R001E: any text projection helper must feed the actual footer and dialog, with the wrong-selection mutant proving reachability.

DONE requires exact-final-tree RED→GREEN, all supported preset and input-path controls, real keyboard/touch/fallback-font evidence, geometry crops, and independent review of focus/safe text/selection. Record source/fixture/host/results and compatibility limits in an evidence comment before manual #25 closure; use non-closing `Implements #25`. Public completion additionally requires a separately authorized deployment and served-source/UI readback.

Rollback only the disclosure/layout delta if geometry or accessibility regresses; preserve existing literal text and keep the access issue open. STOP on incompatible selector/sink drift, unsupported host behavior without a tested fallback, or a requirement to enlarge the embed or change religious date policy. A native title by itself is not acceptable recovery of keyboard/touch access.

Methodology references (separate repository, not Salah work owners): [R001D in IMPLEMENTAUDIT](https://github.com/theislampill/IMPLEMENTAUDIT.md/issues/155), [R001E in IMPLEMENTAUDIT](https://github.com/theislampill/IMPLEMENTAUDIT.md/issues/157).

Identity provenance: first repository-local allocation batch; existing GitHub object order was used to assign distinct monotonic hex-4 IDs. Closed/held IDs are not reused. Issue number is not implementation priority.

title: R0018: Keep prayer timetable text readable over the clear-day scene
body:
<!-- salah-widget-audit-20260907:SW-024 -->
# R0018: Keep prayer timetable text readable over the clear-day scene

**Repository-local identity:** `R0018` in `theislampill/salah_widget`; existing tracker [#24](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/24). The SW identifier is historical draft provenance.


The clear-day timetable loses readable contrast even in the current and next rows. Repair the local text/backing composition so an animated bright sky cannot wash out prayer names and times. Preserve the existing 325×530 card, prayer stack geometry and sky art. This is a corrective readability owner, not a redesign or a general accessibility certification.

Campaign draft alias: SW-024. Existing GitHub owner: #24. P2, product UI defect. The proposal, fixtures and color recipe below have not been implemented or qualified.

## Bound source and historical rendered evidence

Historical main is `fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624`; candidate is `9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb`. Before a future authorized edit record `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, `git remote get-url origin`, `git status --short`, `git rev-parse HEAD`, then `git diff fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 -- index.html DESIGN.md`. Confirm `theislampill/salah_widget`, preserve unrelated work and reconcile incompatible CSS/composition drift. The relevant [main timetable CSS](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L378) and [candidate CSS](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb/index.html#L378) are identical in the recorded comparison.

The historical scene was served from pinned main on a disposable local origin. Its exact recorded URL path/fragment was:

```text
/main/index.html?ui=18#lat=24.47&lon=39.61&label=Madinah&method=4&tz=Asia%2FRiyadh&simTime=12:30&simWx=0
```

`/main/` was the historical server mount; `ui=18` was a cachebuster, not a scene setting. At an ordinary static root use `/index.html` with the same fragment. The recorded procedure waited 2.2 seconds after load for prayer rows and the frozen scene. Host: Chrome 152 on Windows; actual CSS viewport 325×530 and actual DPR 2.28. Device-emulation requests are not proof of the actual viewport.

**The historical civil date was not pinned.** The route and the measurements therefore do not independently establish a repeatable date-specific solar scene. The footer date visible in saved pixels must not be relabeled as a clock-control receipt. The separately selected future acceptance date below is not the historical capture date.

The baseline full-card image shows faint timetable text; its paired background image hides only `.p b,.p .tm` on the same frozen scene. All twelve text rectangles were measured. Source text is 12.5px/600 at line-height 16.7px; computed foreground was `rgb(240,237,248)`. The ancestor `.p.past` has opacity 0.42, while current/next rows have opacity 1. The returned maxima were:

| Row text / time | Group opacity | Maximum changed-pixel contrast, name / time |
|---|---:|---:|
| Fajr / 04:46 | 0.42 | 1.738 / 1.670 |
| Sunrise / 06:05 | 0.42 | 1.802 / 1.628 |
| Dhuhr / 12:19 | 1 | 2.543 / 2.357 |
| Asr / 15:48 | 1 | 2.295 / 2.193 |
| Maghrib / 18:33 | 0.42 | 1.591 / 1.542 |
| Isha / 20:03 | 0.42 | 1.467 / 1.375 |

These are historical changed-pixel measurements, including antialiasing/shadows, not formal WCAG ratios. The source-color/opacity estimates independently supported the low-contrast diagnosis within the same scene, but did not model every blend/backdrop-filter operation. The active rows establish that simply restoring past-row opacity cannot be the whole fix. These are informational schedule values, not disabled controls. Do not reuse an earlier footer 1.6–2.0 claim as a timetable measurement.

Supplementary immutable evidence, relative to the campaign root:

| Artifact | SHA256 |
|---|---|
| `resumption-v1/revisions-v2/evidence/ui/contrast-baseline.png` | `d9aa398cd20183366ad0e2d0ee6a54366ea3c27aa7f4948cf989631a2e856831` |
| `resumption-v1/revisions-v2/evidence/ui/contrast-background.png` | `db2f030704c1366df7df6287ba73effaa2dfc15a6b26b9158b7f9192ed40c9d9` |
| `resumption-v1/revisions-v2/evidence/ui/contrast-rects.json` | `9ee7c658c6b3b44cb7221358e649f777ffd4de643a0998bd17ab174c5a89a795` |
| `resumption-v1/revisions-v2/evidence/ui/contrast-result.json` | `1a068cd670cbdb4b29877fde6d0aac8c8a493991229d5c9337382e199632fbbe` |
| `resumption-v1/revisions-v2/evidence/ui/measure-evidence.py` | `1cc8a35a659ab79c61240374284ee7cd2a0853f96e4c687c64f0893a54ff4bfe` |

Private paths are supplementary; the inputs, findings, method and required future controls are specified here without requiring those files.

## Why this happens and the bounded implementation

`.p` is a translucent white gradient over a varying sky, with backdrop blur/saturation and an accent-dependent `.p.on` background. Its bright background and light foreground can converge. `.p.past{opacity:.42}` then composites the entire row—including any attempted darker backing—through the same low group alpha. Raising only a child's opacity cannot undo ancestor opacity; adding only text shadow does not establish foreground/background contrast.

Use the existing cell as the control surface. Implement and inspect these stages:

1. Preserve the grid columns/gaps, `.p` padding, border width/radius, font sizes/line heights and every row string. Keep names/times at full informational opacity in all states; remove the group-opacity attenuation from `.p.past`. Preserve past/current/next hierarchy using the existing border, restrained cell tint and `.p.now` inset cue rather than making information faint.
2. Give every cell state a bounded dark backing below its decorative tint and a local light foreground. A concrete starting recipe is a shared `rgba(9,17,28,.82)` base with the existing tint gradient layered above it and `#f0edf8` text at opacity 1. This is a proposed starting value, not a tested contrast claim. The `.p.on` background override must compose with the same base; otherwise the next-row rule silently removes the repair. Keep `.p.now`'s distinguishing inset border. Do not change global `--text`, sky colors, solar rendering or all widget glass.
3. Inspect actual inherited filters, blend modes and group opacity that still affect these cells. If the recipe does not provide at least 4.5:1 for ordinary timetable text under intended-color/background evaluation, adjust only the local base/tint/foreground. Do not add a per-frame pixel sampler or weather-specific theme switch to chase contrast: a stable local backing should supply the invariant.
4. Compare the repaired noon crop to the saved/read-only baseline and to the freshly reproduced RED. The intended local change is darker readable cells; the surrounding art, header belt, footer and prayer stack must retain their composition. A globally dimmed sky or opaque full-card overlay is outside this owner.

The tradeoff is reduced translucency inside the existing timetable cells, in exchange for stable access to the core schedule. The exact alpha is allowed to move during controlled pixel review; meeting the readability invariant while retaining the existing geometry and hierarchy decides it. No token framework, theme system, new dependency or layout redesign is needed.

## Separate future fixture and acceptance procedure

Re-establish the RED on the pinned defective tree using a **new controlled fixture**: freeze the browser clock before initialization at `2026-09-07T09:30:00.000Z` (12:30 Asia/Riyadh), use the route fragment above at the actual 325×530 CSS viewport, and return a deterministic day/zone-matching prayer response. This selected future date does not retrospectively pin the historical capture.

For the text-layout control retain the recorded strings Fajr `04:46`, Sunrise `06:05`, Dhuhr `12:19`, Asr `15:48`, Maghrib `18:33`, Isha `20:03`; set Sunset consistently to `18:33`. Bind Gregorian request/payload `07-09-2026`, `meta.timezone="Asia/Riyadh"`, lat/lon `24.47/39.61`, method 4, with usable date data. These strings are fixture values, not certified prayer calculations. Prevent unrelated live responses from overwriting the controlled scene. Capture after rows are present, fonts settle and layout/scene are stationary; elapsed waiting alone does not prove fixture readiness.

Capture the original scene, then add a temporary isolated-fixture rule `.p b,.p .tm{visibility:hidden!important}`, capture the same fixed scene, and remove it. Do not remove the row or change its dimensions. Save the actual viewport, DPR, browser, source revision, clock/zone, font resolution, row classes and rectangles. The historical measurement method maps rectangles from CSS to screenshot pixels, compares baseline/background only where channel change is at least 8, calculates relative sRGB luminance, and reports the maximum contrast among those changed pixels. Its nominal estimate composites authored foreground through the recorded group opacity onto text-free background. Both are useful diagnostics; neither alone certifies full-stack conformance.

| Final-tree case/control | Required result |
|---|---|
| New frozen noon RED→GREEN, twelve text rectangles | The baseline defect is visible before repair; repaired text is readable in the crop and at least 4.5:1 under appropriate intended-color/background evaluation. Cover both opacity-0.42 legacy states and full-opacity current/next states in RED. |
| Day/night/weather | At the same controlled location/date, inspect representative sunrise, sunset, dark night, clear, broken and overcast scenes, with past/current/next classes. Record selected scenes; do not claim every browser or every weather state was originally measured. |
| Local stress background | In an isolated fixture place a bright backdrop under cells, preserving the actual composite structure; every state retains the intended contrast. |
| Opacity mutant | Restore `.p.past{opacity:.42}` only: the past-row control must detect the loss. |
| Next-row mutant | Remove the dark base only from `.p.on`, or restore its original bright-sky background: the active/next control must detect the loss. |
| Geometry and content | Actual `.c` stays 325×530; header/footer remain visible, prayer stack positions and all labels/times stay fixed; compact/long date and stale states still fit their established bounds. |

Use cropped pixels and intended-color composition evidence together. If a measurement says PASS while the image is visibly unreadable, stop; a score cannot override the project’s pixel gate. Keep the claim limited to timetable readability, not all accessibility conformance. Final visual review is sequential under one preview owner to avoid scene/clock interference.

## Ownership, public effects and DONE

`UI-002` owns this repair; fixed-card/compact-footer evidence remains a no-regression control. Write domain is `ui/timetable-css`; no new dependency or relationship delta is proposed. Coordinate any simultaneous art work at exact CSS/composition hunks without absorbing that work into this issue. The shared docs/test integrator owns final insertions.

IMPLEMENTAUDIT R001D: change the relevant `index.html` CSS/backing and [DESIGN readability acceptance](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/DESIGN.md). Update README only if its public claim changes. Builder/configuration/installer/preset remain compatible, with the 325×530 preview/copy/embed contract intact. IMPLEMENTAUDIT R001E does not justify a new metric framework: any added test must exercise the actual cell composition and detect the named mutant.

DONE requires final-tree RED→GREEN crops, composition/contrast results with their limits, geometry/hierarchy controls and independent visual review. Put exact tree/fixture/host/results in an evidence comment before manual #24 closure and use non-closing `Implements #24`. Later public readiness additionally requires authorized deployment and matching served-index plus rendered readback; publishing this work order proves neither.

Rollback only the local text/backing delta if geometry or art controls fail, retaining the issue and failing evidence. Do not preserve a failing opacity value by lowering the acceptance target. STOP on incompatible composition drift, inability to reproduce a visible RED in the new fixture, a conflict with another exact CSS writer, or a proposed global redesign. The unpinned historical date and non-normative changed-pixel ratios remain explicit limitations.

Methodology references (separate repository, not Salah work owners): [R001D in IMPLEMENTAUDIT](https://github.com/theislampill/IMPLEMENTAUDIT.md/issues/155), [R001E in IMPLEMENTAUDIT](https://github.com/theislampill/IMPLEMENTAUDIT.md/issues/157).

Identity provenance: first repository-local allocation batch; existing GitHub object order was used to assign distinct monotonic hex-4 IDs. Closed/held IDs are not reused. Issue number is not implementation priority.

title: R0017: Make smoke outcomes prove required execution without erasing saved settings
body:
<!-- salah-widget-audit-20260907:SW-023 -->
# R0017: Make smoke outcomes prove required execution without erasing saved settings

**Repository-local identity:** `R0017` in `theislampill/salah_widget`; existing tracker [#23](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/23). The SW identifier is historical draft provenance.


Campaign draft alias: SW-023. Instrument/acceptance defect; proposed priority P1. A smoke PASS must mean its required widget checks executed successfully, its persistence tests must leave real settings untouched, and a correctly respected reduced-motion preference must not produce a false failure. These are three accepted subcases of one existing instrument owner, VAL-001/002/009. This issue does not assert that the underlying widget always fails or authorize implementation/publication.

## Bind the repair to main and preserve the evidence limits

The repair target is main `fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624`. Candidate `9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb` supplies comparison evidence only; do not merge or import its extra tests wholesale. In the future authorized checkout:

```text
git --no-optional-locks rev-parse --show-toplevel
git --no-optional-locks remote get-url origin
git --no-optional-locks status --short --branch
git --no-optional-locks rev-parse HEAD
git --no-optional-locks diff fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 HEAD -- tests/smoke.html config.js index.html README.md
```

Confirm the intended `theislampill/salah_widget` checkout and closer guidance; preserve unrelated dirty work. Reconcile relevant readiness, storage, response-consumer and test-interface differences before mutation. Stop on incompatible drift rather than claim the pinned defect exists on arbitrary future HEAD. Main’s tracked tests contain only `tests/smoke.html`; this plan therefore preserves the static-server/browser workflow and adds no browser framework or package dependency.

Exact owners are [harness readiness/persistence/scene handling](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/tests/smoke.html#L49-L127), [motion and summary](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/tests/smoke.html#L167-L203), [config storage methods](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/config.js#L132-L162), [resolve storage consumers](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/config.js#L228-L251), and [candidate harness comparison](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb/tests/smoke.html). Runtime source is read to design faithful fixtures, not to authorize renderer edits.

## What happened and why the existing green is not evidence

The retained 7 September controlled-source probe evaluated the actual `config.js` and smoke script against a Node VM DOM/Storage fixture whose `iframe.contentWindow` was null. The widget never executed. Main reported `21 passed · 0 failed · 13 skipped`, `className=pass`, `__smoke={pass:21,fail:0,skip:13}`; candidate reported 21/0/16 and pass. Missing-config control reported 0/1/13 or 0/1/16 and fail. The harness can detect a missing config module, but its required widget/scene checks turn unavailable execution into skips and the final color only asks whether `fail` is nonzero. Neither a real broken widget nor healthy deterministic integration was exercised by that VM witness.

The same fixture seeded `salah_widget:config:v1` with exact bytes `{"v":1,"lat":12,"lon":34,"label":"fixture-user-setting","method":"4","savedAt":42}` and `unrelated-origin-key=retained`. After the actual smoke, the settings value was null; the unrelated key survived. The missing-config control preserved the original bytes. Calls to `clearLocal()` before precedence/persistence tests and after save/load operate on the loaded production module’s real origin storage. Cleanup is therefore destructive preparation, even if the widget never boots. The audit itself used in-memory storage and changed no real user settings.

Finally, the reduced-motion test installs a reduce=true `matchMedia`, samples the pulse, restores the user’s actual function and unconditionally requires `live!==1`. Main’s [live preference decision](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L661-L665) correctly keeps motion reduced when the restored OS preference is true; the [sun-pulse expression](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L1844-L1849) then yields 1. This is a source-proved false-red conditional, not evidence that accessibility or animation is broken.

## Public RED recipe without private evidence files

Save this as `red-smoke.cjs` in a disposable directory and run `node red-smoke.cjs /absolute/pinned/source-root`. It reads source, evaluates only config/smoke against an in-memory unavailable iframe, and prohibits network. It does not open the public smoke page or touch browser storage.

```js
const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),vm=require('vm');
const root=process.argv[2];
function scripts(html){return [...html.matchAll(/<script\b([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi)]
  .filter(m=>! /\bsrc\s*=/.test(m[1])&&! /type=["']application\//.test(m[1]))
  .map(m=>m[2]);}
async function run(configPresent){
  let ticks=0;const log=[];
  const elements={out:{appendChild(s){log.push({class:s.className,text:s.textContent});}},sum:{},w:{contentWindow:null}};
  class Storage{
    constructor(){this.data=new Map();}
    getItem(k){return this.data.has(k)?this.data.get(k):null;}
    setItem(k,v){this.data.set(k,String(v));}
    removeItem(k){this.data.delete(k);}
  }
  const storage=new Storage(),key='salah_widget:config:v1';
  const before='{"v":1,"lat":12,"lon":34,"label":"fixture-user-setting","method":"4","savedAt":42}';
  storage.setItem(key,before);storage.setItem('unrelated-origin-key','retained');
  class FakeDate extends Date{static now(){return 1800000000000+ticks;}}
  const ctx=vm.createContext({URLSearchParams,Storage,localStorage:storage,Date:FakeDate,Intl,DOMException,console,
    document:{getElementById(k){return elements[k];},createElement(){return {}; }},
    setTimeout(fn,ms){ticks+=ms;queueMicrotask(fn);},clearTimeout(){},
    fetch(){throw Error('Network prohibited in RED fixture');}});
  ctx.window=ctx;
  if(configPresent)vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'config.js'),'utf8'),ctx);
  for(const js of scripts(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'tests/smoke.html'),'utf8')))
    await vm.runInContext(js,ctx);
  return {configPresent,summary:elements.sum.textContent,className:elements.sum.className,
    smoke:ctx.__smoke,before,after:storage.getItem(key),unrelated:storage.getItem('unrelated-origin-key'),log};
}
(async()=>console.log(JSON.stringify({unavailable:await run(true),missingConfig:await run(false)},null,2)))()
  .catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1;});
```

At the pinned RED, the unavailable-widget result is green and settings are deleted; the missing-config result is fail and preserves settings. Those are the historical oracles. The reproduced counts do not become a future acceptance target. Keep the before/after bytes and required-case names so adding tests cannot accidentally satisfy a magic count. This public recipe is transcribed for future use; no new probe execution is claimed by this work order.

## Repair in four ordered stages

### 1. Give required execution an explicit terminal result

Keep `loadUntil`’s exact requested hash check and navigation counter: they prevent a previous iframe scene from satisfying a new request. Add explicit required-case accounting alongside existing pass/fail/skip counters. Each named required case moves from pending to executed only when its actual callback finishes; assertion failure records executed+failed, whereas timeout/missing module remains missing. Await asynchronous callbacks and image decoding with a finite deadline so a hung image cannot leave the summary running forever.

Preserve `window.__smoke.pass/fail/skip` for existing readers. Add an in-memory `status` and named required totals/executed/failed/missing. The terminal rule is: observed assertion or bootstrap error => FAIL; otherwise any missing required case => INCOMPLETE; only complete required execution with zero failures => PASS. Show status, executed/required counts and missing names. Use the existing fail/non-pass style with truthful labels; do not build a dashboard or persisted report schema. A top-level catch/finally must finalize non-pass even when an unexpected callback throws.

All current main checks stay required: config parsing/serialization/precedence/persistence; gateWeatherCode/wxClass availability; dry forecast-thunder, supported rain, fog; calendar and physical moon; absence of painted dawn; cloud identity and observability; waxing/waning orientation; reduced-motion behavior; cloud continuity. Optional live-provider diagnostics must have their own label and cannot substitute for this deterministic required path. Do not call a timeout “offline” unless the fixture/transport actually identified that cause; a missing script, failed bootstrap and unresponsive provider are different observations.

### 2. Isolate storage without changing production settings semantics

Add an optional Storage-like dependency to the existing `storageAvailable(storage)`, `loadLocal(storage)`, `saveLocal(cfg,storage)`, `clearLocal(storage)` and `resolve(hashStr,storage)` methods. Existing omitted-argument callers keep current behavior. Resolve the default `root.localStorage` getter inside the current try/catch boundaries, so blocked storage still returns the current safe failure shape. Thread the same explicit dependency through both local/preferLocal calls to `loadLocal`; this is the easy-to-miss consumer edge.

Use a fresh Map-backed storage object for the smoke’s config/persistence tests and pass it everywhere. A second fixture whose `setItem` throws `DOMException('blocked','SecurityError')` tests denial. Remove the global `Storage.prototype.setItem` monkeypatch. Keep KEY `salah_widget:config:v1`, version 1, normalize/serialize/resolve semantics and default callers unchanged. No storage migration, global mutable test mode or second production config store is introduced.

Sentinel-protect real origin storage outside these fixtures. Original settings, malformed raw bytes, initially absent config and unrelated keys must be byte-identical after pass, assertion failure, callback throw and timeout. The persistence fixture should log or throw on any attempted real-storage access, including the `__sw_probe__` availability check. Do not normalize and resave the sentinel; that is not exact restoration. A save/restore-finally workaround remains vulnerable to another tab and process termination, so do not choose it over a dependency that never reaches real storage.

### 3. Make the healthy browser fixture use the actual widget path

Main’s [fetchTimings](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L743-L758) fetches `/v1/timings/DD-MM-YYYY` with latitude/longitude/method/school, calls `response.json()`, adopts `data.meta.timezone` and returns `data`. [loadPrayerData](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L2142-L2154) assigns today, writes its cache and renders. [model](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L1200-L1223) consumes the six prayer timings plus Sunset; [date formatting](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L686-L691) consumes day/year/month number/name. Supply those inputs rather than setting `prayerLoaded` or replacing render/qaState.

**Selected transport:** add one test-owned static wrapper, proposed `tests/widget-fixture.html`, reached by the default deterministic `loadUntil` path. It uses the same origin and ordinary browser APIs; no Playwright install, new provider, service worker or production hash flag is needed. Load it with the exact requested scene hash and a unique query attempt number. It fetches `../index.html` as source using a captured native fetch, verifies the expected document/script anchors, and records a digest of the fetched source for final-tree binding. Fetch failure/anchor mismatch must display a fixture bootstrap error and never continue with a fabricated widget.

Before parsing the widget document, the wrapper installs its isolated Storage-like object, fixed Date and transport in its own window. Verify the localStorage override by identity before proceeding; if the browser forbids it, fail setup before loading any widget code. The wrapper replaces its document with the fetched HTML, preserving the wrapper URL/hash, adding a base URL pointing to the repo root so `config.js` still loads from its actual public path. Keep wrapper declarations in an IIFE to avoid colliding with widget globals. Instrumentation must be installed before the first widget/config script executes and remain verifiably in place afterward. All widget script bodies stay unchanged; only the test transport/document wrapper differs. Do not evaluate a modified copy of `fetchTimings`.

The pinned head contains [three Google-font resource links](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L3-L10). Suppress those external links in this fixture and add a test-only restrictive resource policy allowing same-origin scripts, inline widget script/style and required data images while blocking remote resources. This makes the healthy fixture independent of external fonts. It therefore qualifies runtime/control behavior only; it cannot certify typography, screenshot parity or M0. Fail on unreviewed added external-resource anchors instead of silently widening the policy.

Freeze no-argument `new Date()` and `Date.now()` to `2026-09-07T09:30:00.000Z`; retain real Date argument construction, UTC and parse operations. Add `tz=Asia/Riyadh` to each deterministic scene hash before navigation, preserving its other simulation parameters and the exact expected hash. With that location/time, the ordinary no-sim-time scene is 12:30 local; explicit `simTime` still drives its existing scene. Performance/rAF may continue normally; this is not the real-time liveness fixture. Start the iframe’s private storage empty on every navigation, so an old prayer cache cannot mask a failed response.

The complete healthy data fixture below is deliberately synthetic, including its Hijri dates. These are test values, not claimed actual prayer times or a conversion of 7 September 2026. Only requested Gregorian date and target request parameters are factual fixture identities.

```js
function prayerFixture(day) {
  // Admit exactly the initial day and its existing tomorrow prefetch.
  if(day !== '07-09-2026' && day !== '08-09-2026')
    throw Error('Unexpected fixture date: '+day);
  const tomorrow=day === '08-09-2026';
  return {data:{
    timings:{Fajr:'05:00',Sunrise:'06:00',Dhuhr:'12:00',Asr:'15:30',
             Sunset:'18:00',Maghrib:'18:00',Isha:'19:30'},
    meta:{timezone:'Asia/Riyadh'},
    date:{
      gregorian:{date:day,day:tomorrow?'08':'07',month:{number:9,en:'September'},year:'2026'},
      hijri:{day:tomorrow?'02':'01',month:{number:1,en:'Synthetic month'},year:'1500'}
    }
  }};
}
```

The fixture-only transport must implement the actual `fetch`/Response interface, log each request and JSON consumption, and have no network fallback. This is the complete decisive routing logic; `mode` and `attempt` come only from the test wrapper query, and `ledger` is new for that navigation:

```js
function fixtureFetch(input, init) {
  const u=new URL(typeof input==='string'?input:input.url, location.href);
  const row={attempt, url:u.href, jsonReads:0, result:'requested'};
  ledger.push(row);
  const day=u.pathname.slice('/v1/timings/'.length);
  const expected={latitude:'24.47',longitude:'39.61',method:'4',school:'0'};
  const allowed=u.origin==='https://api.aladhan.com' &&
    u.pathname.startsWith('/v1/timings/') &&
    Object.entries(expected).every(([k,v])=>u.searchParams.get(k)===v) &&
    [...u.searchParams.keys()].length===4 &&
    (day==='07-09-2026'||day==='08-09-2026');
  if(!allowed){row.result='unexpected-request';return Promise.reject(Error('Unexpected fixture request'));}
  if(mode==='reject'){row.result='rejected';return Promise.reject(Error('Controlled prayer rejection'));}
  if(mode==='hang'){row.result='pending';return new Promise(()=>{});}
  const response=new Response(JSON.stringify(prayerFixture(day)),
    {status:200,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});
  const nativeJson=response.json.bind(response);
  response.json=()=>{row.jsonReads++;row.result='json-consumed';return nativeJson();};
  return Promise.resolve(response);
}
```

All main scene hashes already carry `simWx`, which bypasses both weather and radar fetches in [the actual weather/radar guards](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L771-L773) and [radar guard](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/index.html#L816-L821). Hardcoded coordinates avoid coarse geolocation. Unexpected provider calls must fail the fixture and appear in its ledger; do not silently return success-shaped data for them. The ordinary same-origin source/config resource loads happen before or outside this fetch interception and are explicitly permitted static inputs.

For healthy readiness, require the current attempt/hash, successful fixture setup, at least one logged/JSON-consumed request for `07-09-2026`, actual `qaState().cache.prayerLoaded`, a produced render summary and completion of the named scene assertions. This rejects stale data and a helper that returns without using the real consumer. At fixed 12:30, the supplied timings yield current Dhuhr, next Asr at 15:30 and 180 minutes remaining at the frozen reference instant; allow only the explicitly measured rAF elapsed-time tolerance when using the no-sim-time route. Prefer a frozen `simTime=12:30` integration control for exact 180. Normal tomorrow prefetch may request `08-09-2026`; it receives its matching Gregorian day, not a duplicate current-day body.

Expose wrapper modes `healthy`, `reject`, `hang` and `bootstrap-error` only under tests; reject an unknown mode before loading widget source. Bootstrap-error reports a known fixture failure before widget parsing; reject exercises actual three-attempt fetch failure; hang leaves prayer pending until the harness’s finite required-scene deadline. Start each in a new iframe with empty private storage. All three negative modes must end non-pass, even when the 21 config checks pass. A separate explicitly selected live diagnostic can navigate unchanged `../index.html`, but its provider unavailability must not be counted as a deterministic healthy PASS.

The future local browser command remains the existing workflow: from an authorized disposable copy of the final tree, run `python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1` if Python is already available, or use the existing static server, then open `http://127.0.0.1:8765/tests/smoke.html` in an isolated browser profile. The default selects the healthy wrapper. Run the instrument negatives as separate page invocations with `?fixture=reject`, `?fixture=hang` and `?fixture=bootstrap-error`; their expected non-pass summaries are successful negative-control evidence, not failures to hide inside the healthy summary. A `?fixture=healthy` invocation is the explicit positive. Forward only these validated test modes to each wrapper navigation; optional live mode is separately labeled. Capture every run’s summary, case ledger and console errors. The wrapper is a test-only consumer variation; final integration also needs a bounded check that the actual unchanged index entry still loads on the same final tree. Do not claim exact public entry, production storage safety in every embedding environment or deployed success solely from the wrapper.

### 4. Control reduced motion and restore it without assumptions

Save the iframe’s actual `matchMedia` function. Explicitly set reduce=true, call the real `applyTheme(model())`, and assert the pulse is 1. Then explicitly set reduce=false at a fixed deterministic simTime where the pulse is distinguishable from 1 and check the full-motion branch. Restore the exact original function in finally, including thrown assertions/timeouts; do not assert that restoration must enable motion. If an isolated sample can equal 1, choose the controlled time/interval before execution rather than weaken the oracle afterward.

Run `motion=full` as a separate hash fixture with reduce=true: the override must win. Exercise true/false OS settings in the actual browser while keeping the test’s explicit cases deterministic. A mutant ignoring reduction must fail the reduced case; a mutant ignoring motion=full must fail its override case. Do not change the product’s OS-respecting default to make the smoke pass.

## GREEN and discriminating controls

| Case | Required final observation |
|---|---|
| Null iframe / missing config | Both non-pass; missing required case names differ from an observed missing-module failure. Original storage bytes survive. |
| Healthy fixed response | Actual request and JSON consumption for current attempt; actual prayer load/render; every required scene callback executed; zero required failures/missing. |
| Rejected, hanging or known failed bootstrap | Fresh private cache; bounded non-pass; no blanket offline explanation; successful config checks cannot turn overall status green. |
| Stale previous frame/hash/attempt | Never admitted for the new scene. No late callback can mark another case executed. |
| Existing valid config, malformed raw config, absent config, unrelated key | Exact real-origin bytes/absence preserved after pass/fail/throw/timeout; zero real-storage persistence-fixture calls. |
| Explicit fake saved config + local/preferLocal/hardcoded modes | Same normalization/precedence as default API; test dependency reaches both resolve/load consumers. |
| Fake blocked storage | Existing `{ok:false}`/safe-load failure behavior; no global prototype replacement. |
| OS reduce true/false and separate motion=full | Correct behavior passes under either OS setting; exact function restored; ignoring reduction/override mutants fail. |
| Mutants: suppress required callback, mark timeout executed, seed stale prayer cache, bypass fetch/JSON, omit storage argument in resolve | Named execution/transport/storage oracle fails separately. Useful existing scenes remain required. |
| Default API callers with omitted storage argument | Existing product load/save/clear/resolve behavior retained in an isolated normal-entry control; no schema/key migration. |

Do not use cloud checksums or direct `paintClouds` samples as normal-live M0 evidence. The fixture can check existing weather truth, opaque/calendar moon and no painted dawn behavior, but visual claims still require the UI owner’s crops and real 15–60s motion evidence. Preserve 325×530 widget dimensions, header/footer readability, opaque moon and accessibility. External-font-suppressed/frozen-clock fixture output is explicitly unsuitable as the production appearance/liveness oracle.

## Why this scope, and how it closes

Making all network failures FAIL would confuse flaky provider availability with code regressions while leaving execution unspecified. Leaving all skips green creates the observed false assurance. A deterministic required path plus optional live diagnostics distinguishes those outcomes. A private storage argument is smaller and safer than a global test mode or finally restoring another tab’s changing state. The single reached wrapper replaces neither the widget’s prayer parser nor its renderer; fake qaState/prayerLoaded would bypass the causal path. Adding a package/build system or mandatory browser farm is unnecessary for this static project.

This owner writes `tests/smoke.html`, the narrow config storage seam, the one test wrapper and directly necessary README test instructions. Existing feature owners retain their specific regressions; one test/docs integrator reconciles shared insertions. Smoke trust is required before relying on its result, not a new whole-issue prerequisite for every repair. No new typed dependency or candidate-test adoption is proposed. Installer, builder/preset payload, production rendering and application cache-schema repairs remain outside this owner.

IMPLEMENTAUDIT R001D applies to README’s safe-origin/outcome instructions and any public Pages smoke page: deployed HTML/config/wrapper must match the qualified tree before public safety is claimed. IMPLEMENTAUDIT R001E requires actual wrapper/transport/scene/storage-seam reachability; helper files existing on disk are not acceptance. Historical Pages workflow green is deployment evidence, not application validation.

Rollback must not restore a green missing-widget result or real-storage erasure. If the optional seam harms existing callers, keep the harness explicitly non-pass/safely disabled while reverting or repairing the seam; do not sacrifice settings for a test green. No production data cleanup or schema migration is part of rollback. Stop on incompatible source drift, inability to isolate storage before widget parsing, unsupported wrapper behavior in the actual browser, unexpected network, missing required execution or absent evidence for a claimed public/visual/native result.

DONE requires final-tree RED→GREEN/control results, the real isolated browser transport/healthy/negative paths, default-caller compatibility, and an evidence comment binding commit, source digest, exact commands/fixtures, required-case ledger, storage snapshots, results and limits. Independent exact-tree review is required before relying on the repaired instrument for other acceptance. Public/deployed claims additionally need authorized served-file readback and the public entry evidence actually claimed. Use non-closing `Implements #23` PR wording and manual closure after evidence. This authored work order is not an executed or independently reviewed PASS.

Methodology references (separate repository, not Salah work owners): [R001D in IMPLEMENTAUDIT](https://github.com/theislampill/IMPLEMENTAUDIT.md/issues/155), [R001E in IMPLEMENTAUDIT](https://github.com/theislampill/IMPLEMENTAUDIT.md/issues/157).

Identity provenance: first repository-local allocation batch; existing GitHub object order was used to assign distinct monotonic hex-4 IDs. Closed/held IDs are not reused. Issue number is not implementation priority.

Shared storage-function integration: coordinate with [R0011](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/17) at config.js saveLocal/clearLocal and their callers. Persistence-result feedback and the optional isolated-test storage argument have distinct invariants but touch the same function contract. One writer integrates them, preserving omitted-argument behavior and actual failure results. This is a shared-write constraint, not a requirement to complete either entire issue before preparing the other's controls.

title: R0016: Give both installer dry-run switches an explicit no-effect boundary
body:
<!-- salah-widget-audit-20260907:SW-022 -->
# R0016: Give both installer dry-run switches an explicit no-effect boundary

**Repository-local identity:** `R0016` in `theislampill/salah_widget`; existing tracker [#22](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/22). The SW identifier is historical draft provenance.


Campaign draft alias: SW-022. Product defect; proposed priority P1. Define `DRY_RUN=1` and `-DryRun` as offline previews: read local discovery state and print the intended actions, but make zero filesystem, clipboard, browser, profile, extension or network effects. A preview must neither produce an installable artifact nor tell the next function that a merely proposed path is an existing file.

VAL-008 is a source-confirmed inventory. No full installer or full dry-run was executed in the audit. The tests below are executable future recipes and acceptance specifications, not an invented historical no-effect PASS.

## Source identity and the actual reachability problem

Evidence baseline: main `fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624`; candidate `9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb`. Before authorized repair:

```text
git --no-optional-locks rev-parse --show-toplevel
git --no-optional-locks remote get-url origin
git --no-optional-locks status --short --branch
git --no-optional-locks rev-parse HEAD
git --no-optional-locks diff fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 HEAD -- install.sh install.ps1 README.md builder.html
```

Bind the intended `theislampill/salah_widget` target, closer guidance and unrelated dirty work. Inspect changed launch, cache and staging contracts before using fixed baseline ranges. Stop on incompatible drift; an old source inventory is not proof of a defect at arbitrary future HEAD. Neither candidate adoption nor installation is authorized by this issue.

| Existing path | Historical source finding and why a late guard is insufficient |
|---|---|
| [Bash initialization](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/install.sh#L18-L37) | `DRY_RUN` is set, then `mkdir -p` runs unconditionally before any wizard decision. |
| [Bash clipboard/open](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/install.sh#L71-L109) | `open_url` has a guard, `copy_text` does not. NO_OPEN suppresses opening only; it is not a dry-run substitute. |
| [Bash release/download/extraction](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/install.sh#L248-L320) | Python release lookup performs network before the download guard; mkdir precedes the cache test; extraction removes/recreates a directory and unzips without a guard. |
| [Bash preset/manual callers](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/install.sh#L323-L427) | A dry preset returns a proposed pathname. Cache/existing-file observations and manual instructions must not convert it into a copied/opened actual artifact. |
| [PowerShell initialization and clipboard](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/install.ps1#L24-L88) | `New-Item` runs eagerly; `Copy-Text` calls `Set-Clipboard` without DryRun. |
| [PowerShell metadata, cache and extraction](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/install.ps1#L296-L415) | Metadata has a dry guard, but existing in-process metadata can return earlier; Download-Asset creates a directory and returns cached paths before its guard. Expand-ChromiumAsset deletes/creates/extracts unconditionally. |
| [PowerShell install/store/fallback callers](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/install.ps1#L443-L503) | Cached selection reaches expansion; store and error fallback retain confirmations. A caught selector error is not successful preview of a downloadable asset. |

The actual cached extraction path depends on fixing the separate launch/selector/path failures. An earlier bug masking a later effect is not a protection contract. Conversely, the source inventory does not prove that every listed effect occurred during a real dry-run. Keep that distinction in the eventual evidence comment.

## Public bounded RED: effects become output, never real operations

Use the pinned files. Save the following Node fixture outside the repo as `red-dry-bash.cjs`; run `node red-dry-bash.cjs /absolute/pinned/install.sh`. It executes only extracted helper/initialization excerpts, substitutes mutation/network tools, and writes evidence to stdout/stderr. It does not launch the full installer.

```js
const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');
const lines=fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2],'utf8').split(/\r?\n/);
const x=(a,b)=>lines.slice(a-1,b).join('\n');
const stubs=`set -Eeuo pipefail
DRY_RUN=1
TMPDIR=/fixture
PLATFORM=mac
mkdir(){ printf 'EFFECT mkdir\\n' >&2; }
rm(){ printf 'EFFECT rm\\n' >&2; }
unzip(){ printf 'EFFECT unzip\\n' >&2; }
curl(){ printf 'EFFECT network\\n' >&2; return 99; }
pbcopy(){ cat >/dev/null; printf 'EFFECT clipboard\\n' >&2; }
need_cmd(){ :; }
find(){ printf '/fixture/v1/tabliss-chromium-unpacked/manifest.json\\n'; }
select_asset(){ printf 'v1\\ttabliss-chromium.zip\\thttps://example.invalid/file\\n'; }
[(){ if test "$1" = -f; then return 0; else builtin [ "$@"; fi; }
`;
const code=stubs+'\n'+x(34,40)+'\n'+x(95,114)+'\n'+x(282,321)+`
copy_text fixture
path="$(download_tablissng_asset chromium)"
expand_chromium_asset "$path"
`;
const r=cp.spawnSync(process.env.BASH_EXE||'bash',['--noprofile','--norc','-c',code],{encoding:'utf8'});
console.log({exit:r.status,stdout:r.stdout,stderr:r.stderr});
```

The pinned source calls the mkdir, clipboard, rm and unzip spies despite `DRY_RUN=1`. The asset-selection function is deliberately stubbed here, so this fixture does not prove Python-network reachability; that is visible in the exact source above. The polluted cached stdout is [R0013](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/19)’s separate witness and must not be “fixed” inside this test merely to make a whole-entry claim.

The PowerShell companion below runs on 5.1 or 7 and extracts only `Copy-Text` and `Expand-ChromiumAsset` from explicit UTF-8 text. It illustrates a safe minimum RED independent of the file-decoding owner:

```powershell
param([Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$SourceFile)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $DryRun=$true
$script:effects=@()
function Set-Clipboard { param($Value) $script:effects += 'clipboard' }
function Test-Path { param($LiteralPath) return $true }
function Remove-Item { param($LiteralPath,[switch]$Recurse,[switch]$Force) $script:effects += 'remove' }
function New-Item { param($ItemType,$Path,[switch]$Force) $script:effects += 'mkdir' }
function Expand-Archive { param($LiteralPath,$DestinationPath,[switch]$Force) $script:effects += 'extract' }
function Get-ChildItem {
  param($LiteralPath,[switch]$Recurse,$Filter,$ErrorAction)
  [pscustomobject]@{FullName='C:\fixture\asset-unpacked\manifest.json'}
}
$tokens=$null; $errors=$null
$ast=[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseInput(
  [IO.File]::ReadAllText($SourceFile,[Text.Encoding]::UTF8),[ref]$tokens,[ref]$errors)
if (@($errors).Count) { throw 'Source syntax drift' }
foreach($name in 'Copy-Text','Expand-ChromiumAsset') {
  $defs=@($ast.FindAll({param($n)
    $n -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.FunctionDefinitionAst] -and $n.Name -eq $name
  },$true))
  if($defs.Count -ne 1){ throw 'Function identity mismatch' }
  . ([scriptblock]::Create($defs[0].Extent.Text))
}
$null=Copy-Text 'fixture'
$null=Expand-ChromiumAsset 'C:\fixture\asset.zip'
$script:effects | ConvertTo-Json
```

Run `powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\red-dry-ps.ps1 -SourceFile C:\fixture\install.ps1` and the analogous `pwsh.exe` command. The proposed RED output is the sequence `clipboard, remove, mkdir, extract`. This particular recipe has not been executed in the audit. Inspect actual output and preserve it when future execution is authorized; never report it as historical native evidence.
